author: Athul Prem
scope: Windows CPU resource measurements for the 26-hole layered mesh. The connected pilot prefix keeps the original left impedance and has an artificial free right cut. Prescribed test right-hand sides verify the linear solution. The full-device operator checkpoint uses two matched ports and physical right-hand sides.
measurement: Elapsed seconds are stage wall time. Sampled RSS is worker-tree resident memory. Windows peak working set and private commit are process lifetime high-water marks observed by the end of each listed phase.

source_preallocation.interpretation: The exact factor path requests the same initial buffers for each ordering on this pattern. The estimate explains most of the observed private commit. It gives neither the touched resident bytes nor the numerical factors' storage count.

original_assembly_and_colamd.scope: Connected prefix of the saved layered device. Original left port uses saved outgoing SAFE impedance. Artificial jagged right cut is free. This is a complex factorization resource probe with no applied forcing, scattering response or full-case memory measurement.

batched_assembly_2048.scope: Production batched assembly on the original profiled connected prefix; no factorization.

full_device_operator.scope: Full h200/12-by-4 nominal-Ge 1 GHz left-incidence two-port operator. Public workflow assembly and physical right-hand-side capture only.

full_device_lgmres_initial.interpretation: The returned vector passed both external residual gates and the requested LGMRES tolerance. SciPy checks the residual before each outer update and does not check the last updated vector when the outer loop exhausts its iteration cap. The original driver rejected the raw status before writing a candidate vector.
full_device_lgmres_initial.error: RuntimeError: LGMRES failed for RHS 1 (info=20, relative 9.303e-11, backward 8.166e-14).

full_device_lgmres_checkpointed.repeat_reason: The first LGMRES attempt reached tolerance on its final outer update. The driver stopped on raw info=20 before saving the candidate vector, so the corrected attempt had to recompute it from the saved operator and physical right-hand sides.

full_device_lgmres_public_replay.scope: Cached production scattering postprocessing and export. K/M, SAFE modes and displacement are restored from the saved checkpoint. No FEM assembly, SAFE eigensolve or harmonic iteration.

scattering.amplitude_format: Each complex coefficient is stored as [real, imaginary]. Rows are outgoing modes and columns incident modes at the original end planes.

h160_candidate_preflight.scope: The h160 candidate keeps the h200 mesh's port width, four thickness layers, and 32-segment hole rims. No mechanical assembly or scattering solve was performed.
